title: Keyword Density Checker
h1: Keyword Density Checker — Phrase Share of a Text
description: Measure how often a word or phrase appears in a text, as a count and as a percentage of words. A simple on-page SEO check that stays in the browser.
intro: Paste copy and a target phrase. The checker counts case-insensitive matches and shows what share of the word count that phrase represents.
blurb: Count a keyword or phrase and its percentage share of the text.
howItWorks: Paste the text and enter the word or phrase to measure.
Press Check density. Matching ignores letter case and counts non-overlapping occurrences.
Density is phrase occurrences divided by the number of words, shown as a percentage.
examples: The phrase "free tools" twice in a 100-word paragraph is 2%.
A missing phrase returns 0 matches and 0% density.
Matching treats "SEO" and "seo" as the same phrase.

faq.a: Not by itself. This only reports frequency. Readable copy usually mentions a topic naturally instead of repeating a phrase in every sentence.
Words are sequences separated by whitespace. The phrase count uses a case-insensitive search and does not overlap itself.

faq.q: Is the copy uploaded for analysis?
faq.a: No. The count runs in your browser and is not stored.
